rationale: The workflow already implements the evidence-supported dependency-caching optimization (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE): both the lint and typecheck jobs restore the pnpm store from actions/cache, keyed on hashFiles('**/pnpm-lock.yaml'), and both still run pnpm install plus their required checks (pnpm lint / pnpm type_check), so coverage is preserved. The actionlint job installs no dependencies (it only runs the docker://rhysd/actionlint action), so it has nothing to cache. The only other candidate with measured evidence is P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT (adding timeout-minutes), but its precondition requires representative successful-duration history; the supplied CI history contains run IDs and timestamps but no durations, and the contraindication warns that cold dependency installation plus lint/typecheck could exceed an arbitrary limit. No matrix exists for fail-fast, and there are no scheduled workflows for schedule-based patterns. No supported change is warranted.
